tempo_shift.why: No systems changes: the General/systems sections are empty, and the only non-hero change is an item (Healbane), which moves builds rather than soul income, fight locations, or timers. Tempo therefore inherits the 10-30 state — comeback levers plus richer Haunts — unchanged.

systems.intent_read: A hero-and-item micro-patch on top of the 10-30 gameplay update: the hero list (Apollo, Baba, Celeste, Deadman Danny, Mo & Krill, Nurse Harrow, Rat King) plus Healbane reads as targeted cleanup of outliers from that update rather than a new systemic direction. Valve is not touching economy, comeback, map or objectives, so the 10-30 thesis — leads must be converted fast, the jungle keeps paying the trailing team — still stands. Any movement this patch comes from individual kits and anti-heal itemization, not from how the game generates souls or where fights happen.

items.summary: Only the stacking curve moved: one source of anti-heal is exactly as strong, so nobody's single purchase decision changes. But the second-through-fourth sources pay less (4-stack ceiling 82.2%->72%), which quietly reverses part of the 10-30 'anti-heal is a team coverage plan' move and restores relative value to kit-based sustain.

affected_heroes.why: Healbane is his answer to sustain comps; the payoff for adding it on top of a teammate's heal-cut is now materially smaller, so his counter-build is less of a hard counter.

His Toxic Bullets 40% heal-cut plus Healbane is exactly the two-source case trimmed 57.8%->54.7%, but the same change leaves his Spirit Lifesteal/Napalm sustain less punished by enemy stacked anti-heal — roughly a wash.
The anti-heal bruiser variant's whole selling point was built-in heal cut stacking with Healbane/Toxic Bullets; that composition is the nerfed case, so his edge into healer comps shrinks.
He still buys Healbane for self/team anti-heal, but the dome and Healing Booster throughput he sells is now harder for a team to fully shut down with multiple anti-heal sources.
The 10-30 stack system was the worst change for her tether heals; capping the stack ceiling partially un-does that, though her gun core remains the correct build.
He buys Healbane himself, but more importantly his post-10-30 problem was starting fights small — a weaker anti-heal ceiling on his regen stack buys back some of the buffer Radiant Regeneration lost.
Scorn sustain is his survive-the-fight engine; less effective stacked anti-heal on him is the one item-side gain for a tank whose spirit damage was gutted on 10-30.
Restorative Locket carries his sustain after Healing Booster was gutted, and that heal is now harder to fully suppress with stacked anti-heal.

items.build_shift: No component or slot change — it stays a Vitality T2 — but its marginal value collapses for a team's second and third buyer, so on a comp that already has one Healbane the slot now competes with any other Vitality item instead of reading as free coverage.

notable_item_stories: Anti-heal is back to being a slot you buy rather than a coverage plan you draft: single-source Healbane is untouched, so expect fewer triple-Healbane comps and a small rebound for kit healers (Kelvin, Ivy) and self-sustain bruisers (Shiv, Mo & Krill).

The losers are the heroes who used Healbane as a second layer over their own heal-cut (Infernus with Toxic Bullets, Drifter's built-in cut, Seven into sustain comps) — that specific stack is now worth about 3 points less at two sources and far less at four.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's 4-stack ceiling 82.2%->72% means his Spirit Lifesteal/Napalm sustain is harder to fully suppress — a real but small gain.
The same change weakens his own Toxic Bullets + Healbane two-source package (57.8%->54.7%), which was his answer to dedicated healers.
build_changes: Treat Toxic Bullets as a damage item first; the 40% heal-cut stacked on Healbane is no longer a hard anti-sustain combo.
Keep one anti-heal source on the team, not two — the second buyer gets ~3 points of heal-cut instead of coverage.
heroes.one_liner: His burn-lifesteal shell survives stacked anti-heal a little better, but his own Healbane answer is softer — a wash.

indirect_reasons: Healbane sits in his spirit AoE core as the sustain-comp answer; with the 2-stack case 57.8%->54.7% and the ceiling 82.2%->72%, that counter-build is less of a hard counter.
Ivy (a listed Seven loss, ~47%) is one of the clearest Healbane-stacking winners, so the tether he could previously shut down comes back.
build_changes: Keep Healbane as your single anti-heal slot, but if a teammate already runs it, spend that Vitality slot elsewhere — the second source is now worth far less.
No change to the Monster Rounds/Cultist Sacrifice farm spine; the jungle economy is untouched.
heroes.one_liner: Still the fastest farmer in the game; Healbane is just a worse second buy when a teammate already has it.

indirect_reasons: Celeste took a kit-wide nerf (Shining Wonder slow -32%->-28%, cooldown 160->170s, Radiant Daggers cast range 30->25m) and is one of Vindicta's worst lanes at 46%.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing in her notes; one bad lane (Celeste) got gutted, but the flyer tax is unchanged.

indirect_reasons: She buys no Healbane, so the anti-heal stack trim is pure upside: Radiant Regeneration and Mystic Regeneration are harder to fully suppress.
Drifter's anti-heal bruiser variant (Veil Walker/Healbane/Tankbuster) is the composition the stack nerf hits hardest — and Drifter is a listed Geist loss.
Celeste, one of the falling spirit-caster rivals her Soul-Exchange line was measured against, lost cast range and slow.
build_changes: Regen core (Extra Regen/Mystic Regeneration/Radiant Regeneration) is now slightly more reliable out of the dive — no swap needed.
heroes.one_liner: Stacked anti-heal can't choke her regen as hard anymore, so the sustain bruiser gets a small refund.

indirect_reasons: He doesn't buy Healbane, so the stack trim only helps: Siphon Life and his regen shell are harder to shut off with multi-source anti-heal.
Celeste (45% vs him, spirit burst that outranges a static frontline) took a kit-wide nerf — small relief on a listed loss.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched; the anti-heal ceiling drop just makes his Siphon sustain slightly harder to answer.

indirect_reasons: Celeste (a listed loss) lost silence duration and slow, trimming one bad lane.
Ivy's tether heals are now harder to stack anti-heal onto, and Ivy is also a listed loss — roughly cancels the above.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched again: one bad lane got easier, another got harder, nothing in her gun core moved.

indirect_reasons: Celeste's nerf trims one of the AoE spirit bursters that clears her turret stacks.
Lady Geist's regen survived the anti-heal trim, and her AoE spirit burst is also a turret-clearing counter.
Her own Healbane only appears in the niche zoning build, so the stack nerf barely touches her.
heroes.one_liner: No notes: her turret farm is untouched, and the Celeste/Geist bursters that clear her zone traded one for one.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, a listed loss at ~46%, lost Radiant Daggers cast range 30m->25m, T3 silence +1.25s->+0.75s and Shining Wonder slow -32%->-28% — the out-trade lane gets noticeably softer.
heroes.one_liner: No lines for her; one losing lane got weaker, which doesn't fix a 46% hero.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill — his worst listed loss — got Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow damage radius +0.5m and Combo health per kill 40->50, so the durable frontline that eats Singularity is better at exactly that.
Sand Blast T2 now slows -28% (from -24%) and cuts dash distance -28% (from -26%), making his engage easier to peel.
No item driver: he buys no Healbane and nothing in his Extra Charge/Arcane Surge/Refresher spine moved.
build_changes: Keep Unstoppable/Refresher on the channel — expect more Mo & Krill frontlines that survive the whole ult.
Value Mystic Expansion/duration for wider Singularity pulls rather than trying to out-burst the frontline.
heroes.one_liner: Still wins the scheduled hub fights, but Mo & Krill's buffs make the wall that eats Singularity taller.

indirect_reasons: Healbane one source is untouched but the ceiling dropped 82.2%->72% and stacks decay 20% faster — the multi-source anti-heal plan that was his worst system change can no longer fully shut off Frozen Shelter or Healing Booster.
Drifter, a listed Kelvin loss, leaned on the anti-heal bruiser composition this nerf targets.
build_changes: Healbane stays a fine buy for your own team anti-heal; don't expect a second or third source on the enemy team to blank your dome anymore.
Extra Regen/Healing Booster spirit core is unchanged — keep funding heal throughput.
heroes.one_liner: Stacked anti-heal can't fully blank the dome now, so the best healer in the game gets quietly better.

indirect_reasons: Celeste (47% vs her, burst that beats her before Fixation stacks) lost T3 silence +0.5s of duration, slow and 5m of cast range — a real listed loss softened.
Apollo gained a Riposte disarm plus a longer T2 disable (+0.6s->+0.7s) and Itani Lo Sahn T3 +50%->+60%; the disarm directly turns off her gun window, though the pommel is an immobilize, not a stun.
build_changes: Watch the melee-range lane against Apollo: a Riposte disarm now blanks your Fixation window, so hold Surge of Power or reposition instead of trading through it.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched; Celeste's nerf helps her, Apollo's new Riposte disarm makes the lane trades riskier.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill — a matchup she currently wins (~52%) — got Sand Blast T2 to -28% slow and -28% dash distance (from -24%/-26%), a bigger Burrow radius (+0.5m) and Combo health per kill 40->50 — the point-blank lockdown she plays into often got stronger.
Her own anti-heal/Healbane exposure is nil, so the item change does nothing for her.
build_changes: Buy Unstoppable/Debuff Reducer earlier into Mo & Krill — the -28% slow and larger Burrow radius make the entry harder to escape.
Lean on bounce-pad pre-placement rather than reactive lasso commits into the tank frontline.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing in her notes. Mo & Krill's slow and Burrow got stronger, but she currently wins that matchup.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, a listed counter (he wins 44% into her), lost Dazzling Trick silence (T3 +1.25s->+0.75s), Radiant Daggers range (30m->25m) and Shining Wonder cooldown (160s->170s) — a small relief in a lane he was losing.
Healbane's stacked ceiling falls 82.2%->72%, so the sustain that already erases his burst (Kelvin, 42%) is now harder for a second buyer to cut — a small extra tax on the hook combo.
heroes.one_liner: No lines for Bebop; a single-target hook still has nothing to punish in this economy.

indirect_reasons: Apollo, roughly an even matchup for her, added a Riposte Pommel Hit disarm, a parry-ending Pummel and T2 duration 0.6s->0.7s; a disarm barely touches her melee-spirit burst, so the squeeze is small.
heroes.one_liner: Untouched kit, untouched jungle income — still a sharper diver with no safety net.
Nothing in this patch fixes a sub-50% flyer with no camp or crate route.

direct_reasons: Scorn heal from heroes 1.2x->1.3x raises the sustain that is his survive-the-fight engine.
Burrow damage radius +0.5m makes the AoE his camp clear and dive both wider.
Combo health per kill 40->50, so finishing the grab pays more than it did.
Sand Blast T2 re-tunes the slow/dash cut to a flat -28% (from -24% slow / -26% dash): slightly stronger on both axes.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacking ceiling drops 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay, so the multi-source anti-heal aimed at his Scorn sustain is materially weaker.
Celeste, his 46% matchup, ate kit-wide nerfs (Dazzling Trick silence T3 +1.25s->+0.75s, Shining Wonder 160s->170s), removing kiting pressure from a lane he loses.
build_changes: Scorn 1.2x->1.3x rewards holding Scorn for hero contact instead of burning it on a camp; with the anti-heal ceiling capped, one Healbane on the team is enough — second and third copies are no longer worth a slot.
Combo HP per kill 40->50 pushes the kill-complete play over poke: Burrow in, grab, finish — not a Burrow-and-walk-away.
heroes.one_liner: More Scorn healing, a bigger Burrow, +10 HP per grab — the tank holds targets and now survives doing it.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's stack ceiling falls 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay, so the Radiant Regeneration + Spirit Lifesteal shell he fights out of is far less punishable by a team's second and third anti-heal source.
His own Healbane is a single source and is untouched — his heal-cut into bruisers does not change.
build_changes: Do not re-add out-of-combat regen: Radiant Regeneration is still in-combat-only, but stacked enemy anti-heal is now weaker, so Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse carry the buff instead of another regen slot.
heroes.one_liner: Weaker stacked anti-heal buys his regen stack back some buffer; he still starts fights smaller than pre-10-30.

indirect_reasons: The 10-30 multi-source Healbane stack that specifically crushed tether healing is capped: 4-stack 82.2%->72%, 2-stack 57.8%->54.7%, decay 20% more aggressive.
Mo & Krill — a matchup she currently wins (~53%) — gained Scorn 1.2x->1.3x, +0.5m Burrow radius and +10 Combo HP per kill, so his displacement threat still improves.
build_changes: Run exactly one Healbane on the team, not three: the first source is unchanged and the marginal second/third slot is now worth more as any other Vitality item.
Healing Booster/tether support gets a small relative rebound; the gun core (Titanic Magazine/Tesla Bullets) is still the build to fund.
heroes.one_liner: The anti-heal stack ceiling came down, so her tethers hold longer — gun core is still the build.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked cut is weaker, so the sustain he has to cage through (Ivy 48%) is marginally harder to suppress, and Mo & Krill — who tanks his cage — took direct Scorn/Burrow/Combo buffs.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing for Warden this patch; his late gun window is the same race against the clock.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, a listed loss (~47%), lost Dazzling Trick silence duration (T3 +1.25s->+0.75s), Radiant Daggers range (30m->25m) and Shining Wonder cooldown (160s->170s).
Mo & Krill — a matchup she currently wins (~52%) — got Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x plus Burrow radius and Combo HP buffs, so the sustain tank got harder to burst, offsetting the Celeste gain.
heroes.one_liner: Celeste's nerfs open one lane, but the sustain tank she cannot burst just got tankier.
Untouched, still the top-pick initiator — nothing here blunts the grapple-dive loop.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill, his 43% frontline loss, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow damage radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50 — the tank-sustain that already out-trades him got better.
Healbane's stacked ceiling falls 82.2%->72%, which helps sustain comps generally but gives his own poke-and-Cube shell nothing specific.
heroes.one_liner: No lines for Viscous, and the M&K buff makes the frontline he loses to harder to grind.

indirect_reasons: Celeste, his 39% worst matchup, lost Dazzling Trick silence (T3 +1.25s->+0.75s), Radiant Daggers range (30m->25m) and Shining Wonder cooldown (160s->170s) — the burst that out-ranged him is smaller.
Healbane's stacked cut (82.2%->72%) makes team heal-cut weaker, which marginally hurts a DoT-burst carry trying to close through sustain; small and second-order.
heroes.one_liner: Celeste nerfs soften his worst lane; the Affliction ramp still needs the game to last.

indirect_reasons: Mo & Krill, his 40% matchup, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50 — the silence/combo that already locked him down got stronger.
His own Healbane is a single source and is unchanged (57.8%->54.7% only hits the second source), so his anti-heal core buys the same thing it did.
build_changes: Keep one Healbane, not two: the second copy on your team now pays about three points less heal-cut.
Split-push still converts worse than corridor farming after 10-20 — route through camps and take Djinn's Mark picks on isolated clearers.
heroes.one_liner: The split-pusher gets nothing back, and the tank that silence-locks him got stronger.

indirect_reasons: No direct lines; Mo & Krill — a matchup she currently wins (~54%) — gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x and +0.5m Burrow radius, making the lift/combo dive on her a little cleaner.
Healbane's multi-source nerf does not reach her: no Healbane in her gun core and no kit sustain to protect.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing in the notes for her; Mo & Krill got tankier but she currently wins that matchup, so the ~50% sits still.
Untouched again: no item in his duration/cooldown shell moved and his divers did not change.

indirect_reasons: Her two worst listed matchups both eased for the enemy: Mo & Krill got Scorn 1.2x->1.3x plus +0.5m Burrow radius, and Ivy gains from the Healbane stacking cut.
Weaker stacked anti-heal does nothing for her single-target rotation, which already loses to sustain.
heroes.one_liner: Same 44.7% niche: the tanks she can't kill (Mo & Krill) and the healer she can't out-burst (Ivy) both got slightly better.

indirect_reasons: Healbane's 2-source cut 57.8%->54.7% specifically devalues his anti-heal bruiser variant, which stacked his built-in heal cut on top of Healbane/Toxic Bullets.
Apollo's Riposte rework (added disarm, T2 +0.6s->+0.7s) sharpens a listed loss, and Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x->1.3x hardens another.
build_changes: Default to the spirit melee core (Melee Lifesteal/Stalker/Spirit Strike); the anti-heal bruiser package is now the weaker buy into healing comps.
heroes.one_liner: Still a blind-pickable bruiser, but his anti-heal variant lost its edge and two of his losing lanes got buffed.
No lines, and neither his trap-clearer Graves nor his tank counters moved; he is the same ~46% gun-bruiser.

indirect_reasons: Anti-heal stacking is a listed counter to his grind-down shell, and the 4-stack Healbane ceiling fell 82.2%->72%, so Spirit Lifesteal/Healing Booster sustain is harder to fully suppress.
Offset: Mo & Krill, a 47% matchup for him, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x and Combo 40->50 health per kill.
heroes.one_liner: Quietly helped: the anti-heal that counters his sustain shell got weaker, and his own numbers are untouched.

indirect_reasons: Multi-source Healbane is listed as the anti-heal counter to her heal/lane-pressure shell, and its 2-source value fell 57.8%->54.7% (4-stack 82.2%->72%).
Ivy, her toughest support matchup, gains from the same anti-heal cut, so the heal-duel stays roughly even.
heroes.one_liner: 55.6% lane bully untouched, and the stacked anti-heal teams used to answer her heals is weaker now.

indirect_reasons: Apollo's Riposte rework (added disarm, T2 +0.6s->+0.7s) sharpens a dive-tempo lane he already loses; his own spirit/charge shell took no item hits.
heroes.one_liner: Same late setup initiator at 45.6%: the Bell carry build is untouched, one dive counter just got a disarm.

indirect_reasons: Stacked anti-heal is listed as his counter, and multi-source Healbane just lost value (4-stack 82.2%->72%), buying his brawl a little more room.
Offset: Mo & Krill, the frontline that already out-brawls him, gained Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x and Combo 40->50 health per kill.
heroes.one_liner: Roughly a wash: anti-heal teams hurt him less, but the tank he beats got a bit more sustain.
Nothing touches her shell — no Healbane in it, no counter buffed — so the 56.9% top win rate stands.

direct_reasons: Riposte Pommel Hit now also disarms, turning his parry punish into a hard shutdown of a gun carry's M1 window on top of the existing immobilize.
Riposte T2 duration +0.6s->+0.7s and Itani Lo Sahn T3 +50%->+60% bonus damage both lengthen or strengthen the pick he already converts.
Pummel hit now ends a preexisting parry on the target — the least clear line (it strips the enemy's parry state rather than Apollo's), so treat one edge of this kit as unresolved.
indirect_reasons: Restorative Locket is his sustain slot and heal-stacking via Healbane is now weaker (2-source 57.8%->54.7%), so enemy anti-heal coverage of his Locket shell shrinks.
build_changes: Value Riposte as a duel/pick tool vs gun carries now that it disarms — hold the parry for their sustained-fire commit rather than fishing for channel interrupts (it is still an immobilize, not a stun).
heroes.one_liner: Riposte now disarms, holds 0.1s longer, and Itani Lo Sahn T3 hits harder — his pick punish finally has teeth.

Ivy, the support who owns his slot in the heal duel, gains from the same change, so the item-side lift doesn't win him the pick.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-heal stacking got weaker, which is worth more to a percent-HP healer than anything else in this patch.

indirect_reasons: Rat King's bullet damage 5.7->5.8, ammo 24->26 and Rule, Ratannia! T1 -25s cooldown strengthen the hero who beats her ~58% — a real cost in her worst lane.
Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2%->72% makes her Melee Lifesteal/Restorative Shot sustain harder to fully suppress, a small offset.
heroes.one_liner: Nothing for her directly; Rat King got better and anti-heal got worse, roughly a wash at 46%.

direct_reasons: Dazzling Trick T3 silence +1.25s->+0.75s cuts her pick window by 40% on the ability that sets up her burst.
Radiant Daggers cast range 30m->25m (the range bonus moved to T2) forces her closer, and the spirit amp per stack 7%->6% (moved to T3) trims the payoff of the same ability.
Shining Wonder nerfed on every axis: slow -32%->-28%, cooldown 160s->170s, bounce 15.5m->15m, T1 slow -16%->-14%, T2 damage +90->+80.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% slightly relieves her Spirit Lifesteal/Torment Pulse sustain, but she never bought the item herself so the gain is one-sided and small.
build_changes: Shining Wonder at 170s is a fight-defining cast, not a rotation tool — stop valuing ult uptime and buy damage/uptime elsewhere.
Silence T3 1.25->0.75s weakens the pick setup; lean on Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse as the sustain layer rather than the gutted regen shell.
heroes.one_liner: Every tool she picks with got shorter: silence, cast range, ult slow and ult cooldown all down.

direct_reasons: Rule, Ratannia! T1 now also cuts 25s of cooldown, directly buying back part of the 180s ult timer that was his post-10-30 problem.
Bullet damage 5.7->5.8 and ammo 24->26 feed the Monster Rounds/HVR gun-bruiser core that is his primary build.
Rule, Ratannia! move speed +3m->+4m improves the banner window he uses to force hub fights.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2%->72% makes his regen/Fortitude frontline harder to fully suppress — the anti-heal answer to him is weaker.
Baba's spirit-resist scaling 0.7->0.5 and melee damage -10% remove pressure from a fellow S-tier frontline contesting the same crates and hubs.
build_changes: Take Rule, Ratannia! T1 earlier — the -25s cooldown is now the cheapest fix for the 180s ult, ahead of Superior/Compress Cooldown.
Scrap Grenade fuse-extension 0.4s->0.25s makes the melee-the-fuse trick less reliable; pull camps with melee first, then grenade the clump.
heroes.one_liner: Buffs land on the exact spots 10-30 hit: ammo, bullet damage, banner speed and a 25s ult cooldown cut.

direct_reasons: Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5 is a ~29% cut to the resist wall her regen bruiser build stands behind.
Melee damage per boon -10% and Granny Long Legs melee/debuff resist 30%->25% trim both her heavy-melee crate clear and her brawl durability.
Baba's Brew cooldown 27s->28s, cycle 1.5s->1.6s and burn spirit scaling 0.15->0.13 slow the random-order brew she already cannot control.
indirect_reasons: Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% is a small relief for a regen-wall hero, but single-source anti-heal is untouched so the counter still works.
Rat King's bullet damage, ammo and ult-cooldown buffs strengthen the frontline she competes with for crates and hub space.
build_changes: Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5 makes resist-stacking slots worse — put the spend into cooldown/duration (Compress Cooldown, Superior Cooldown) instead.
Melee damage -10% per boon weakens the Granny Long Legs crate route; still open Tough Crates, but stop treating melee as a damage source.
heroes.one_liner: Resist scaling and melee both cut again, but a 56.6% win rate says she is still a top frontline.

Healbane's stacked ceiling 82.2%->72% does nothing for him: his usage data shows no Healbane, so the anti-heal change is neutral here.
heroes.one_liner: His two worst matchups got nerfed, but a buffed Rat King offsets most of that.

direct_reasons: Close The Deal bonus damage to under-half targets +75%->+55% cuts the execute that defines his dive-pick identity by a fifth.
Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8% hits the ability his primary spirit-mark build scales everything into.
Chimera Mk1 T2 heal-on-hit 150->125 and heal spirit scaling 2.0->1.7 remove sustain from a 730-HP flyer who has to commit to every dive.

heroes.one_liner: Execute cut to +55%, Salvo scaling down 8% and the jetpack heal trimmed — the dive pays less.

Baba's spirit-resist scaling 0.7->0.5 and melee -10% soften one of her 41% losing lanes; Rat King's buffs worsen the other.
heroes.one_liner: Anti-heal stacking got weaker, which is the one thing her regen-heavy build needed; still 50.8%.

# Meta state
Last patch: Minor Update - 11-04-2026 (2026-11-05)

## Thesis
Games are still won by converting a lead into Guardians and Walkers before the comeback economy pays the trailing team, and off-lane Haunt farm is still the income engine for both sides. What changed is the mid-fight: stacked anti-heal is weaker, so kit healers and self-sustain bruisers hold their bars longer, and the outlier frontlines (Baba, Celeste, Deadman Danny) were trimmed. One-cycle camp clearers who spend a lead early and late scalers with a farm floor remain the winners — the fight just lasts longer now.

## Economy and systems
- Comeback: non-hero comeback gold capped at 30% (was 26%), tick souls routed to the two lowest-econ players, deficit-scaled secure rate up to 50% faster on contested Haunt souls. Sitting on a lead is a losing line.
- Kill income stays contested: the Soul Bag must be last-hit after the kill. Bounties: Guardian +10%, Walker +5%, objective share 30->25% (09-16, holds).
- Objective parries no longer reset the parry cooldown — Guardian/Shrine dives are one-shot.
- Respawn 38s at 20m. Global slows -20%; air drag ratio 0.5 — airborne exits slower, ground kiting stronger, flyers taxed.
- Steam Vents keep invisibility and add +150% stamina regen. Cast-on-press holds; Healing Snacks 10% max HP.
- Anti-heal: Healbane's first source is unchanged, but stacking is trimmed (2 sources 57.8->54.7%, 4 sources 82.2->72%, stacks decay 20% faster). Anti-heal is a slot again, not a team coverage plan.

## Map
Lanes renamed; four districts plus off-lane corridors. All neutrals are one of nine Haunt types that group and chase — bounty and growth +10%, HP and damage +10%. Tough Crates (58 souls, Heavy Melee only), Barrel Mimics, Sinner's Sacrifice variants, and Buff Containers rolling permanent Move Speed, Bullet/Spirit Resist and ability range; a Halloween candy-cauldron layer rewards Heavy Melee. Hubs: Sunken Plaza (~5-8 min, stamina strip) and Bell Tower (8+, ~280 souls, one rope, three vaults, map-wide bell). Green lane holds a roof/tree above the bridge. Arch Mother's side owns Sunken Plaza plus the theater.

## Archetype standing
- AoE one-cycle camp clearers: up — richer Haunts barely cost them HP (Seven, Infernus, McGinnis, Mina, Yamato).
- In-fight lifesteal bruisers: up — lifesteal cluster buffed while out-of-combat regen was cut (Victor, Infernus, Drifter).
- Dedicated healers: up, reversing 10-30 — the stacking system that blanked them is capped, so Kelvin, Ivy, Rem, Paige and Nurse Harrow all hold longer.
- Heavy-melee frontline/tanks: stable — Baba's resist scaling 0.7->0.5 and melee -10%/boon trim the wall, but Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow/Combo buffs replace it (Abrams, Mo & Krill, Billy, Shiv).
- Out-of-combat regen sustain: still down but relieved — Radiant Regeneration is combat-only, yet stacked anti-heal no longer fully suppresses it (Baba, Shiv, Lady Geist, Violet).
- Max-range poke/gun carries: down — HVR velocity, Express Shot and air drag still bite; Celeste lost 5m of cast range and most of her silence (Vindicta, Grey Talon, Paige).
- Roamers/pick assassins: mixed — slower tunnels and Shadow Weave setup, but Apollo's Riposte now disarms gun carries and Deadman Danny's execute fell to +55% (Lash, Holliday, Paradox, Calico, Apollo).
- Lane bullies: slightly down — the comeback floor blunts snowball conversion (Paige, Apollo).
- Late scalers: up — comeback gold and tick souls fund the slow curve (Pocket, Mirage, Warden).
- Flyers: down — air drag 0.5 plus reliable grounding; Deadman Danny's Salvo scaling and jetpack heal both cut (Grey Talon, Celeste, Vindicta, Deadman Danny).

## Watchlist
- Healbane purchases per team: if the average falls toward one, the coverage plan is dead and kit healers rebound further.
- Kelvin, Ivy and Rem win rates — the cleanest read on whether the stacking cap is worth ~3 points of heal throughput.
- Deadman Danny pick and win rate: a fifth off the execute should show fast on a dive hero.
- Celeste's T3 talent pick rate: if players abandon the silence talent, her identity shifted, not just her numbers.
- Mo & Krill pick rate into frontline-heavy lobbies, as the answer to Baba and Viscous.
- Graves snapshot 57.5% WR still conflicts with the KB's 48.5% / 21% — nothing here touches her kit, so recheck.

## Recent history
- Minor Update - 11-04-2026: hero-kit cleanup only — Baba, Celeste and Deadman Danny trimmed, Rat King, Apollo and Mo & Krill fed, Healbane's stacking curve cut.
- Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update (2026-10-30): comeback levers (30% non-hero cap, tick souls to the two poorest, faster secure when behind), Haunt bounty/growth and HP/damage +10%, Steam Vents add +150% stamina regen, ~30 item moves — regen out, in-fight lifesteal and stacked anti-heal in.
- Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit (2026-10-20): off-lane corridors and hub fights priced in; Haunt behaviors, Barrel Mimics, Steam Vents, Healing Snacks, instant casts; Graves gun destroys Venator traps.
- Paint the Town (2026-10-16): nine Haunt camp types replace all neutrals, contested Soul Bags, objective-parry cooldown reset removed, permanent-stat Buff Containers, six vote-gated new heroes.

Mo & Krill.why: Still the default sustained front line — Scorn/Burrow, Torment Pulse's +4% melee resist and Combo keep him a lockdown tank — and 11-04 gives back some of what 10-30 took: Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50, plus weaker stacked anti-heal. Spirit per boon 0.6 still means he holds targets without threatening them.

Halloween 2026: base gun damage +3%, Bloodscent T3 +11%->+12% amp, Eternal Night T3 +2.5->2.75s; Haunt bounty/growth +10% raises his crate/vent roam income and multi-source anti-heal now composes with his built-in heal cut.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Steam Vents, new hiding spots and heavy-melee Tough Crates extend his stealth-roam and give his melee core uncontestable crate income.

Victor.why: Sustain frontline the patch fed: Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser and Torment Pulse compound his grind-down shell, and Healbane's stacked ceiling falling 82.2->72% makes the anti-heal that counters him weaker. Healing Booster's rework still delays his early curve.
Victor.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Healbane's 4-stack ceiling 82.2->72% weakens the stacked anti-heal that counters his sustain shell.
Halloween 2026: Aura of Suffering T3 +15%->+16%; Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser (6->8 spirit, 75% active lifesteal) and Torment Pulse +4% melee resist feed the grind-down core, while Healing Booster lost its Extra Regen link and +3 regen — buy it standalone, later.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; harder Haunt camps, longer PvE routes and Buff Container Bullet/Spirit Resist rolls feed his sustain stack — A held.

Paige.why: Still the best lane-winning support, but base bullet 35->32 is roughly a 9% lane cut and the comeback economy rescues the carry she used to snowball past. Healbane's multi-source cut weakens the stacked anti-heal teams used to answer her heals, so the conversion is less punished than on 10-30.

Paige.notes:
11-04: no direct change; multi-source Healbane cut (2-stack 57.8->54.7%, 4-stack 82.2->72%) weakens the anti-heal answer to her heal shell.
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: base bullet 35->32 (~9% lane cut; growth 0.52->0.61 pays back later); HVR velocity 60->45 weakens her 1.2-min buy — Opening Rounds before HVR is now the safer opener, and comeback gold blunts the lead she converts.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Healing Snacks let her lane pressure stick instead of resetting on a recall, and lane-adjacent crate routes from ~2:30 pay the lane winner immediately — S held.

Apollo.why: Riposte now disarms gun carries and holds 0.1s longer, so his parry punish converts picks instead of just interrupting; Itani Lo Sahn T3 +60% adds burst. Still an immobilize, not a stun, so channeled ults do not break.
Apollo.notes:
11-04: Riposte Pommel Hit adds a disarm, T2 +0.6->+0.7s; Itani Lo Sahn T3 +50->+60%; Pummel ends the target's preexisting parry (wording unclear). Still an immobilize, not a stun.
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Riposte Pommel Hit is now an immobilize + parry disable, not a stun — 0.8->1.5s (T2 +0.4->+0.6s) with dash reliability fixes and CC refunds on Flawless Advance/Itani Lo Sahn. He loses the channel interrupt (Seven/Bebop/Harrow ults) and Healing Booster's gutting thins his sustain; S held, trend rising -> stable.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; lane pressure converts into lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks, but the objective-parry change makes the Guardian dive a one-shot decision — S held.

Rem.why: Coin-flip support whose percent-max-HP heal gains relative value now that stacked anti-heal reaches 72% at four stacks instead of 82.2%; still loses the heal-slot duel to Ivy and the Mo & Krill buffs sharpen a listed loss.
Rem.notes:
11-04 Minor: no direct change; Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2->72% protects his percent-HP heal from multi-source anti-heal, but Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs sharpen a listed loss — held D/rising.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; harder corridor camps raise the value of his percent-max-HP heal on the farm route, but Healing Snacks do part of his job for free and he still loses the heal-slot duel to Ivy — held B/rising.

09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; harder camps reward his sustain and spread-out vaults (Bell Tower now three) strengthen his map play, while Healing Snacks slightly cheapen dedicated healing - trend up (peercontent).

Celeste.why: Flying spirit burster whose pick tools all shrank — silence T3 +1.25->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30->25m, Shining Wonder slow/cooldown/bounce/damage down — on top of the 10-30 sustain-shell gutting, so she has neither a safe angle nor a reliable pick window.
Celeste.notes:
11-04 Minor: measured C -> B post-patch. Dazzling Trick T3 silence +1.25->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30->25m and 7->6% spirit amp, Shining Wonder slow -32->-28%, cooldown 160->170s, bounce 15.5->15m, T2 +90->+80 — every pick tool shrank at once.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: B -> C. Shining Wonder 140->125 is the note; the real hit is Radiant Regeneration (0.35->0.25 spirit regen scaling, heal-on-cast 65->40, in-combat only) plus Healing Booster losing Extra Regen and +3 flat regen, into buffed Decay/Toxic Bullets/stacking Healbane. Spirit Shielding 18->15%, HVR 60->45% velocity and Metal Skin's +20% gravity compound it; pivot to Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; the off-lane/corridor economy gives her no camp or crate income route, and Barrel Mimics tax a low-HP clearer, so the tempo patch keeps her B/falling.

Rat King.why: Still the 116-heavy-melee frontline who opens Tough Crates and forces hub fights, and 11-04 gave back exactly what 10-30 took — ammo 24->26, bullet damage 5.7->5.8, banner move speed +4m and a -25s ult-cooldown talent — so his camp-clear and reset are back online.
Rat King.notes:
11-04 Minor: measured S -> A post-patch. Bullet damage 5.7->5.8, ammo 24->26, Rule, Ratannia! move speed +3->+4m and T1 now -25s cooldown; Scrap Grenade fuse-extension 0.4->0.25s makes the melee-fuse trick less reliable.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: S -> A. Scrap Grenade 70->60 (T2 +70->+60, T3 300->275), fuse +0.1s; Rule, Ratannia! knockup halved, 160->180s and now goes on cooldown if he is stunned before placing; base bullet -5% and growth -20%. Haunt camps +10% HP finish the one-button clear. Offsets: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Tough Crates, grouped chasing Haunts, forced Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza hubs and Barrel Mimics all point at heavy-melee camp-clear frontlines, so the systems patch lifts him A -> S on fit, not numbers - confirm against win rate before locking.

Baba.why: Grounded regen bruiser whose resist wall and melee both got cut again — Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5, melee damage -10% per boon, Granny melee/debuff resist 30->25% — so the crate-clear and brawl durability that carried her S tier are thinner, even at a 56.6% win rate.
Baba.notes:
11-04 Minor: S held (measured). Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5, melee damage -10% per boon, Granny Long Legs melee/debuff resist 30->25%, Baba's Brew cooldown 27->28s, cycle 1.5->1.6s and burn scaling 0.15->0.13 — the resist wall and crate-clear both thinner.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: C -> D. Baba's Brew order is random each cast on a 1->1.5s cycle (silence 3->2.75s), spirit-resist scaling 0.1->0.07, Threadsap 22->16s and cleanse now wipes stolen spirit, Granny heavy-melee slow 4->2s; Radiant Regeneration (94% buy) and Healing Booster both gutted into an anti-heal patch. Offsets: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; the new corridors, grouped Haunt camps and forced Bell Tower/Plaza fights suit her melee-regen clear and arrest the post-10-14 fall, but the barrier/resist cuts still bind - trend falling -> stable at C.

Solomon.why: Zone-control support whose Bishop is the damage while his gun lane stays gutted; two of his three worst lanes (Baba, Celeste) were nerfed in 11-04, but Rat King — the third — was buffed, so the floor rises without a tier move.
Solomon.notes:
11-04 Minor: no direct change; Baba (spirit-resist scaling 0.7->0.5, melee -10%) and Celeste (silence/cast range/ult) were nerfed, but Rat King — his other listed loss — was buffed, so the floor rises without a tier move — held D/stable.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: base bullet 30->25 and -20% headshot gut the HVR/Opening Rounds lane crutch, Rook Battery 1.3->0.9 scaling is a real damage cut, Develop Queen 210->240s; Setup Bishop is now the damage (0.64->0.85 on-square, T1 slow +25%, T3 shred -5%/stack on impact) and checkmate is base kit. Max Bishop over Rook Battery. Three losing matchups (Rat King, Baba, Celeste) ate major nerfs. C held.

Usage overrides the day-0 'Barrier support' and full-gun builds: Divine Barrier/Healbane/Healing Booster/Superior Duration and Swift Striker do not appear in high-rank item data. Vindicta now reads 48% (even), not the day-0 loss; Baba still 36% despite the 10-14 front-line cut (her barrier 1.2->0.7, -7% bullet resist, B->C).

Deadman Danny.why: Spirit mark-burster whose dive-pick identity got taxed again — Close The Deal execute +75->+55%, Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8%, Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125 — on a 730-HP flyer who must commit; the mark no longer finishes targets above half HP.
Deadman Danny.notes:
11-04 Minor: measured B -> S post-patch. Close The Deal execute +75->+55%, Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8%, Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125 and heal scaling 2.0->1.7 — the dive-pick pays less and the mark no longer finishes targets above half HP.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Chimera Mk1 nerfed across the board — jetpack unusable while cursed, slows now cut jetpack impulse harder (worse under movement-ability silence), grounding pulls land more reliably. HVR 60->45% velocity hits his lone weapon staple; the Close The Deal damage fix is the only gain. C held, trend rising -> stable.

7-day check-in (2026-10-20): tier C -> C, WR 45%, PR 69% over 446352 matches. Corrected: the usage data kills the 'shred/mark gun' identity - Bullet Resist Shredder does not appear at all, and the real build is spirit (Extra/Improved Spirit, Mystic Burst at 79-90%) with HV Rounds as the lone weapon staple. The old beats list was inverted - Celeste (33%) and Graves (32%) are among his worst lanes, not wins. PR 69.1% is a new-hero novelty spike (previously 0.2% on a two-day sample), so read WR 38.5% and ignore pick rate. Held C/rising: the build finally consolidated and WR gained ~3.6 points, but nothing clears 49% head-to-head and the flyer tax is intact; upgrade only on ~45%+ WR, drop to D if the spirit capstone stays a post-30-min luxury.

Violet.why: Zone caster whose ult was cut on every axis at 10-30 and whose regen stack (Radiant Regeneration 96%, Mystic Regeneration 93%, Healing Booster 78%) now faces a weaker stacked anti-heal ceiling (82.2->72%), the one item-side relief her build needed; still 50.8% and no escape.
Violet.notes:
11-04 Minor: no direct change; Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2->72% is the one item-side relief for her Radiant Regeneration/Mystic Regeneration/Healing Booster stack, while Baba's resist/melee cuts soften a listed loss and Rat King's buffs worsen another — held B, trend falling -> stable.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: B -> C. Abstract Landscape 165->180s, 0.04->0.01 duration scaling, ends on death, 0.5->0.75s re-apply and T3 ink destructible again; Still Life stun 1.0->0.9s, LOS required at channel end, T1 regen only while drawing (0.25->0.15). Spirit Lifesteal 6->8 spirit / 13->15% is the replacement sustain; anti-heal stacking taxes the rest.

Data corrects the day-0 read: B/rising was a tooltip judgment, so C is a correction, not a decline — 46.1% WR at 70.9% PR, and she loses to frontline brawlers rather than punishing melee. Watch whether her WR climbs with reps; the tooltip read also claimed Seven and the gun line as wins, but Seven is 49% over 170 and Living Ink/HVR no longer appear in her item data at all. 10-20 Shh...: no Violet changes; her position moves on systems (Haunt grouping, Tough Crates, hub fights) and on the dive/frontline meta around her.

Nurse Harrow.notes:
11-04 Minor: B held. Bullet damage +8%, Lurking Terrors fear buildup 2->1.75s and vertical angle 50->65% — faster, wider lockdown steadies a falling A-tier; single-source anti-heal still answers her healing-based sustain.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Lurking Terrors fear buildup 1.3->2s, T3 immunity -> 50% damage reduction, no fear from >50° above/below the target's view; base gun damage -10%, Healing Needles 25->22 (T2 +20->+16) but spirit scaling 0.2->0.24; Leech Therapy ground leeches 180s -> 120s + 3s/min and cleared on round reset. Anti-heal buffs land on a dedicated healer. B held, trend stable -> falling.

7-day check-in (2026-10-27): tier B -> B, WR 51%, PR 63% over 607252 matches. Data overrides the day-0 read: Swift Striker, High-Velocity Rounds and Active Reload show no meaningful share (Titanic Magazine is the weapon core at 98% / 6.7m), and the 7-day spread contains none of the dash assassins the fear-cone thesis predicted. Extra Regen is not the trap the previous note called it — 97% at 2.1m with a baseline win rate makes it a mandatory lane tax for 0 base regen, indifferent rather than informative. Changelog: released 2026-10-20 in Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit., first full-week check (7.3k matches, no creator content); nearly every item WR sits at 50.5-51%, so build-level signals are weak and confidence is capped.

Healbane.notes: 11-04 trimmed only the stacking curve: one source of anti-heal is exactly as strong as before, but the 2-source case falls 57.8->54.7%, the 4-source ceiling 82.2->72%, and stacks decay 20% faster. This partially reverses the 10-30 'anti-heal is a team coverage plan' move — the first purchase is still correct, the second and third are now worth roughly any other Vitality slot. Buyers who stacked it over their own heal-cut (Infernus with Toxic Bullets, Drifter's built-in cut, Seven into sustain comps) lose the most; kit healers and self-sustain bruisers (Kelvin, Ivy, Rem, Shiv, Mo & Krill) get a relative refund. Solomon dropped from the buyer list — no Healbane in his usage.
